claims: Sony is increasing PlayStation 5 prices globally starting April 2, 2026.
Sony's PlayStation 5 price increase is due to economic pressures.
Sony's PlayStation 5 price increase marks the second hike in less than a year.
The new U.S. price for the standard PS5 is $649.99.
The standard PS5 U.S. price is increasing by $100.
The new U.S. price for the Digital Edition is $599.99.
The Digital Edition U.S. price is increasing by $100.
The new U.S. price for the PS5 Pro is $899.99.
The PS5 Pro U.S. price is increasing by $150.
The PlayStation Portal handheld price will rise to $249.99
